checks.criterion: home is Person's today and does not force Project selection
advice is limited to 1-3 and questions to 0-1 only when the answer materially affects safety, inclusion, ranking or next step
each advice exposes next step, why now, source/artifact/derivation basis, freshness, certainty, scope, safety degradation, evidence access and feedback/pause controls
advice neither creates nor executes an action automatically
home-level controls distinguish accept, modify, reject, ignore, defer, answer, execution/result report, correct and revoke/pause

conclusion: The candidate supplies a visible, bounded advice-and-question contract rather than an opaque task wall or automated agent contract.
